acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Top-down proteomics; Data-independent acquisition

The mass spectrometer was operated in positive ion mode and data-independent acquisition mode (DIA) using isolation windows of 16 m/z with a precursor mass range of 400-1000, switching the FAIMS between CV-45V and -60V with three scheduled MS1 scans during each screening of the precursor mass range.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: For on-bead digestion of immunoprecipitated proteins, bead mixtures were subjected to cysteine reduction (1.5 mM dithiothreitol for 15 min at 30°C), followed by alkylation (7.5 mM iodoacetamide, 30 min at RT).

alkylation_reagent.evidence: For on-bead digestion of immunoprecipitated proteins, bead mixtures were subjected to cysteine reduction (1.5 mM dithiothreitol for 15 min at 30°C), followed by alkylation (7.5 mM iodoacetamide, 30 min at RT).

cleavage_agent.evidence: Bead mixture was diluted to 2M Urea with 100 mM ammonium bicarbonate and digested with 100 ng trypsin (Promega) overnight at 37°C.

enrichment_method.evidence: 1 ug of CIP2A antibody was added to the pre-cleared whole cell lysates for 1 hours and tumbled end-over-end at 4 degrees Celsius.
Subsequently, magnetic DynabeadsTM Protein G beads for immunoprecipitation were added to the lysates and incubated for another hour at 4 degrees Celsius.
